name: sudoku
description: 可安装的网页数独：计时、个人排行榜、历史复盘、中途暂存续玩。纯静态 PWA。

scripts.test: node tools/test-engine.mjs && node tools/test-game.mjs && node tools/test-dom.mjs && node tools/test-ui.mjs && node tools/test-restore.mjs
scripts.deploy: node tools/deploy-schema.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy web --project-name=sudoku
scripts.app:open:android: cd app && npx cap open android
